title: Volume Analysis

edits.reason: This is the worked breakout trade. The chart draws the coil low (idx13 'Vol Declining — Coil') and the breakout spike (idx14 'VOLUME SPIKE! Breakout ✓') but stops there visually — the follow-through the spike confirmed is undrawn. Text: 'Spike in volume on the break = confirmation of direction — this is what you are waiting for' justifies marking the post-breakout continuation to ~108 at idx17 (last bar of the to:108 leg, in range 0–17, band 84–108). The 'Coiling Range' area shades the tightening consolidation between the coil low (~87) and the Breakout Level (92) that the existing 'Vol Declining — Coil' point and the intro line 'Decreasing volume inside a consolidation = healthy coiling before the move' describe; it sits above the existing 'Support Zone' 83–87 so it is a distinct band, not a duplicate. Teal matches the chapter's pre-bullish-break convention.

notes: REJECTED the auditor's introChart markLine {yAxis:108 'Exhaustion High'}: 108 is in-band and the 'Potential Reversal' point sits near it, BUT introChart is a concept slot whose six markPoints already walk all four price/volume scenarios, and the text teaches the price–volume relationship ('potential trend exhaustion and reversal ahead') without naming any specific tradeable exhaustion LEVEL. Adding a level line over-annotates a concept chart and the auditor itself rated it 'low'. Per the restraint/slot-fit rule, dropped. ACCEPTED both lessonChart gaps (re-derived independently): the continuation markPoint and the coiling-range area, both directly text-justified and coordinate-sane. quiz.chart confirmed already-complete: cutIndex:5 keeps the decision un-spoiled and revealMarkPoints carry the outcome (Low Volume / Tiny Body Exhaustion / Reversal Begins) post-answer; no pre-cut annotation should be added.
